summary: Iteration 69 — Verified the new 'المحفوظات' (Design Archive) feature end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass against the live preview URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) covering (1) GET /snapshots schema (kind+label+is_baseline on every item), (2) POST /snapshots/manual happy path with custom Arabic label, (3) manual save with no label defaults, (4) repeated manual saves 6+ times with NO -20 cap (verified count grew), (5) manual on unknown PID → 404, (6) manual on empty current_html → 400, (7) first POST /publish creates kind=baseline + 2nd publish creates kind=publish (NOT a 2nd baseline), (8) POST /snapshots/{sid}/restore pushes pre_restore BEFORE swap and newest-first ordering returns pre_restore at top, (9) regression /approve-design <500. Frontend Playwright on live preview confirmed: tab-chat + tab-archive + tab-live all render (DOM order = chat|live|archive, which the review explicitly says is acceptable); clicking tab-archive renders archive-save-manual button + archive-card-* cards + archive-thumb-* thumbnails + archive-restore-* + archive-edit-from-* buttons. The 'الأساس' Pin label is present in the DOM. POST /snapshots/manual was triggered from the UI by clicking archive-save-manual and the card count refreshed to 4 (the seeded snapshots came back into view). One unconfirmed item — the 'عدّل عليها' prefill text 'استلمت النسخة السابقة من المحفوظات...' was NOT found in any textarea on first attempt; could not re-verify reliably due to slow archive-load on the dev preview (yarn webpack-dev-server is sluggish — initial GET /snapshots takes >10s to render in DOM despite the API responding in <200ms). Main agent should self-verify this prefill manually.

integration_issues.issue: Could not confirm that clicking [data-testid^='archive-edit-from-'] populates the chat composer textarea with 'استلمت النسخة السابقة من المحفوظات...'. The window.confirm() was auto-accepted by the Playwright dialog handler but no textarea ended up containing the seeded prompt within 6s. May be timing-related (slow dev server) — recommend main agent verifies manually or via a deterministic state-spy.

issues: DOM tab order is [tab-chat, tab-live, tab-archive] — review_request says either order is fine, but visually in the RTL preview the 'Snapshots' tab ends up on the FAR LEFT of the bar (because tab-archive is the LAST DOM sibling and RTL flips order). The user's stated request put 'المحفوظات in the middle'. Consider swapping the JSX order so DOM = [chat, archive, live], which renders RTL as [live | archive | chat] keeping archive in the middle visually.

action_items: Manually verify the 'عدّل عليها' (edit-from) flow on /freebuild/chat/{pid}: click archive-edit-from-*, accept the window.confirm, then check the bottom chat composer textarea is prefilled with 'استلمت النسخة السابقة من المحفوظات...' AND activeTab switched to 'chat'. Backend restore call works; only the UI prefill side needs a confirm.

(Optional UX) Reorder the tabs so 'المحفوظات' sits in the middle visually (request literally said 'يكون في المنتصف' was implied by the user's 1a/2a/3c choices). Currently DOM = [chat, live, archive]; recommend [chat, archive, live].
critical_code_review_comments: freebuild_chat.py is now 7671 lines — far past the 700-line guideline. The Design Archive logic (list/manual/restore/baseline) is sprinkled across L114-220, L585-595, L3607-3735, L6700-6823, L7050-7065. Recommend extracting into a dedicated module /app/backend/modules/freebuild/design_archive.py with its own router so the surface is auditable.

_make_snapshot_doc at L585 is correct but the publish path at L3716-3735 swallows ALL exceptions (`except Exception: publish_snapshot_push = None`) and continues silently — if the snapshot insertion ever fails the user gets no warning and history is corrupted. At minimum logger.exception() should be added there.

Manual save endpoint (L6784) uses Form("") for label which is fine, but the 80-char truncation `(label or 'حفظ يدوي').strip()[:80]` is silent — UI sends a placeholder up to ~50 chars so this is OK in practice, but consider returning the truncated value in the response so the UI can warn.

Frontend FreeBuildChat.js L1280 restore() uses window.confirm() — this works but blocks E2E automation. Consider switching to a shadcn AlertDialog with data-testid so future Playwright tests can deterministically accept/reject.
FreeBuildChat.js is 5851 lines — split DesignArchiveTab (L1235-1535) and ArchiveThumb (L1543-1590) into separate files under /app/frontend/src/pages/freebuild/ for maintainability.

ArchiveThumb fetches html_snapshot HTML per-card via fetchHtml() — for projects with 300+ snapshots (user's stated goal) this will hammer the API. Recommend the LIST endpoint returns a tiny html_preview (first 4KB) per snap so the grid can lazy-render iframes without N extra round-trips.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 — all archive endpoints verified including no-cap, 404, 400, baseline-once, pre_restore-on-top)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (tabs render, save-manual works, cards/thumbs/restore/edit buttons all in DOM with correct testids; preview overlay testids confirmed in code; only edit-from prefill text could not be confirmed via Playwright due to slow dev server)
